pf2e-weather-forge.settings.weatherPrevi: Stores the current preview before it is accepted.
pf2e-weather-forge.description.clearMild: The air is calm and pleasant. A serviceable travel day, with no temper from the sky.
pf2e-weather-forge.description.lightRain: Fine rain settles on clothes and roads. The world feels muted, as though sound has been tucked beneath a wet blanket.
pf2e-weather-forge.description.heavyRain: Rain crashes down in heavy sheets. Puddles grow quickly, cloth clings to skin, and armor sounds dull beneath the drops.
pf2e-weather-forge.description.snow: Snow falls in cold veils. Steps grow quieter, shapes soften, and the air bites between breaths.
pf2e-weather-forge.description.overcast: A thick ceiling of cloud hangs over the area. The light is flat and the mood crouches low.
pf2e-weather-forge.description.windy: The wind tugs at cloaks, hair, and loose straps. Conversations must wrestle with the howl of the gusts.
pf2e-weather-forge.description.coldClear: The air is clear and cold. Each breath briefly exists in the world before vanishing.
pf2e-weather-forge.description.hotClear: Heat lies heavy over the land. Metal grows unpleasantly warm and shade feels precious.
pf2e-weather-forge.description.extreme.s: A storm rules the area. Gusts tear at everything, rain strikes sideways, and the sky feels like an angry beast.
pf2e-weather-forge.description.extreme.h: The heat stands in the air like glass. Every movement costs more strength than it should.
pf2e-weather-forge.description.extreme.c: A hard cold has sunk its teeth in. Fingers stiffen, breath burns, and even sounds feel brittle.
pf2e-weather-forge.description.extreme.f: Dense fog swallows distance and shape. The world ends a few steps ahead.
pf2e-weather-forge.description.extreme.b: Snow and wind merge into white roaring. Keeping your bearings becomes a die roll against the sky.
pf2e-weather-forge.notification.weatherA: The weather preview has been accepted.
pf2e-weather-forge.notification.weatherR: The weather has been reset for the selected climate zone.
pf2e-weather-forge.settings.calendarStat: Stores the Weather Forge internal Golarion calendar.
pf2e-weather-forge.notification.calendar: The internal calendar has been saved.
pf2e-weather-forge.description.mist: Low, damp mist hangs in the air and swallows sound like wet felt.
pf2e-weather-forge.description.thunderst: Heavy clouds tower overhead, thunder rolls across the land, and rain lashes down in gusts.
pf2e-weather-forge.settings.weatherHisto: Stores accepted weather states for later review.
pf2e-weather-forge.settings.historyLimit: Controls how many calendar days are kept in the weather history.
pf2e-weather-forge.history.title: Weather History
pf2e-weather-forge.history.hint: Stores each accepted weather state by date and time segment. Entries remain fully localizable because keys are stored instead of finished display text.
pf2e-weather-forge.history.empty: No weather history yet. Accept a preview to store the first entry.
pf2e-weather-forge.notification.historyC: The weather history has been cleared.
